answer: The anchor report reveals the merge explicitly at each signal. Each collapsed cluster gets one raven weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, anyone who spins up 289 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 10 times the capital for one share. A farm of 2743 identities would post 4859 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
